deepseek-v4-flash-preview.desc: DeepSeek V4 Flash, MQ2-Lloyd routed-expert MoE (arch_id=9). Includes MTP sidecar for K=2 spec-decode (+29% TG on code) and a DSpark 3-stage drafter sidecar (auto-wins over MTP under --spec dspark/auto). temp=1.0 is safety-critical: greedy/low-temp falls into token loops on the quant.

deepseek-v4-flash:mq2lloyd.desc: Official DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 MQ2-Lloyd package (arch_id=9). The cache defaults to the implemented F32 route; F16 is selectable on the certified gfx1201 MQ2R TP route. Parent-faithful profiles use low effort with temp=1/top_p=1 by default, max effort with temp=1/top_p=0.95 for agentic coding, and no hidden thinking cap. Includes the checkpoint-aligned DSpark sidecar. Was the default SKU until 2026-08-14, when MQ2R took over on the contributor's recommendation; retained and reachable as deepseek-v4-flash:mq2lloyd or deepseek-v4-flash-0731:mq2lloyd.

deepseek-v4-flash.desc: Official DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 MQ2R (arch_id=9), quantized with the preserved P3 tensor recipe. The cache defaults to the implemented F32 route; F16 is selectable on gfx1201 TP3/TP4 for long-context capacity. Parent-faithful profiles use low effort with temp=1/top_p=1 by default, max effort with temp=1/top_p=0.95 for agentic coding, and no hidden thinking cap. Includes the target-aligned DSpark sidecar. Default SKU since 2026-08-14 (recommended and blessed by nwoolmer, the DeepSeek V4 contributor): 4.0 GB smaller than MQ2-Lloyd and the certified gfx1201 TP route. The previous default is retained as deepseek-v4-flash:mq2lloyd.

minimax-m2.7.desc: MiniMax-M2.7 Mixtral-style 256-expert MoE (arch_id=10). MQ2 SKU (~79GB); fits gfx1151/96GB or multi-GPU EP. Card temp=1.0/top_p=0.95/top_k=40 + default identity system prompt.

maple-preview.desc: Deepgrove Maple-Preview 20B-A1B (arch_id=15). NATIVELY TERNARY: every linear weight ships as {-s,0,+s} with one bf16 scale per output row, so MQ2G256LloydU (qt=51, 2.250 bpw) carries the body VALUE-EXACTLY — a packing, not a quantization; max|err| vs the bf16 master is 0. lm_head is Q8: measured +23.9% decode for +0.00005 nats of mean KL, with top-1 agreement and PPL both slightly BETTER than bf16 (MQ4 head was rejected — 2.6x the KL, concentrated on the model's most-confident positions). 24 layers, 256 experts top-8 on every layer, 3:1 sliding(512)/global-NoPE attention, QK-norm before partial RoPE, clamped SwiGLU. Reasoning model (<think>), Qwen tokenizer, ChatML + <tool_call> tools. ~1530 tok/s prefill, ~158 tok/s decode on gfx1151. NOTE: wikitext PPL ~57 (a peer scores ~7.7) — that is the MODEL, not the packing: KL vs a bf16 reference is 0.084 and the vendor's own ternary GGUF scores within 0.2%. Upstream calls it a preview with minimal agentic post-training.

north-mini-code.desc: CohereLabs North-Mini-Code-1.0 (Cohere2-MoE, arch_id=12). MQ4 4-bit. Agentic code model: parallel block, sigmoid 128-expert MoE; <|START_THINKING|>/<|START_TEXT|>/<|START_ACTION|> tool-call format. ~880 tok/s prefill, ~37 tok/s decode on gfx1151.

ornith-1.5:35b-a3b.quant_recipe: published-trunk plus qt13 shared-expert replacement from parent 10fbf86f using MQ4G256V2
ornith-1.5:35b-a3b.desc: MoE 35B/3B-active VL finetune (Qwen3.5 family). Routed experts and all 96 formerly-MQ4V1 shared-expert projections now use MQ4G256V2; census: 20,747 MQ4G256V2, 43 MQ6G256, 112 Q8F16, 191 F16, zero MQ4G256V1. Parent-card sampling (temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, no presence penalty) is validated with thinking enabled and disabled under VMM. Vision tower ships as ornith-1.5-35b-a3b.vl alongside the trunk. NOTE: the .mtp is a REPLACEMENT draft head derived from shisa-ai/Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-MTP-ONLY (Apache-2.0), not the head from the Ornith 1.5 release. See the repo README and NOTICE. Low/medium/xhigh effort steering defaults to xhigh and has no implicit think-token cap.

ornith-1.5:35b-a3b-mq4r.desc: Official Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B uniform MQ4G256V2 Redline SKU, quantized from ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B@10fbf86f with --format mq4 --no-q8-router --uniform. Census: 20,871 MQ4G256V2 (qt44), 31 Q8F16, 191 F16, zero qt13 and zero qt15. Parent-card sampling is temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, no presence penalty. The optional .mtp is the separately published replacement head documented by the model card. Low/medium/xhigh effort steering defaults to xhigh and has no implicit think-token cap.
